Job Description

Join Us as a Site Contract Specialist – Make an Impact at the Forefront of Innovation
We have successfully supported the top 50 pharmaceutical companies and more than 750 biotechs, spanning 2,700 clinical trials across 100+ countries in the last 5 years.

As part of our team , you’ll have the opportunity to prepare and negotiate contracts, as well as finalize the contract process. As a Site Contract Specialist, you'll liaise and establish effective relationships with sites and internal functional teams. You will ensure quality, objectivity, and risk analysis in the efficient delivery of contracts.

What You’ll Do:
• Drafts, reviews, negotiates and finalizes agreements with study sites in accordance with local/accepted process.
• Negotiates within approved parameters both investigator grant budget negotiation parameters, contractual terms and conditions in accordance with company contractual considerations, client contractual considerations, established process with sites and follows established escalation routes.
• Ensures compliance to established negotiation parameters, authority approval, contractual process and client expectations.
• Ensures compliance of budgetary guidance, templates and process.
• Identifies and assesses legal, financial and operational risks and escalates to appropriate level of the organization per established processes.
• Provides recommendations and alternative resolutions to Investigator Contracts negotiations through established escalation channels.
• Coordinates with internal functional departments to ensure various site startup activities are aligned with contractual activities and mutually agreed upon timelines; ensures alignment of contract negotiation process for sites and study are properly aligned to the critical path for site activation.
• Achieve target cycle times for site activations.
• Ensures guidelines and processes are followed for efficient escalation of out of parameter issues as appropriate.

Education and Experience Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree or equivalent and relevant formal academic / vocational qualification
• Previous experience that provides the knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the job (comparable to 2-5 years).
In some cases an equivalency, consisting of a combination of appropriate education, training and/or directly related experience, will be considered sufficient for an individual to meet the requirements of the role.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:
• Good understanding of the principles of contract law, including a general understanding of laws that influence contract language, such as business, intellectual property and local tax and stamp laws
• Demonstrated ability to apply basic principles of investigator grant negotiation
• General understanding of business and financial principles that related to service agreements
• Effective communication skills (verbal & written) in English and local language
• Capable, with appropriate oversight, of drafting and negotiating contract provisions and budgetary issues within parameters
• Demonstrated ability in attention to detail
• Excellent analytical and decision based thinking skills
• Understanding of the pharmaceutical product development process and involvement of CROs
• Able to work independently or in a team environment
• Good organizational and time management skills
• Working knowledge of PPD SOP & WPDs
• Able to organize competing priorities logically and review outstanding contractual risk and issues
• Able to effectively use automated systems and computerized applications
• Ability to demonstrate a customer focused style of communication, problem solving and collaboration

Working Conditions and Environment:
• Ability to work in an upright and /or stationary position for 6-8 hours per day.
• Repetitive hand movement of both hands with the ability to make fast, simple, repeated movements of the fingers, hands, and wrists.
• Frequent mobility required.
• Occasional crouching, stooping, with frequent bending and twisting of upper body and neck.
• Light to moderate lifting and carrying (or otherwise moves) objects including luggage and laptop computer with a maximum lift of 15-20 lbs.
• Ability to access and use a variety of computer software developed both in-house and off-the-shelf.
• Ability to communicate information and ideas so others will understand; with the ability to listen to and understand information and ideas presented through spoken words and sentences.

• Regular and consistent attendance.

jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the #1 ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work (https://www.bain.com/about/awards-recognition/) list and have maintained a spot in the top four on Glassdoor’s list since its founding in 2009. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH 

Join a group of talent acquisition experts who are the top of their field for attracting and hiring the top of every other field. We manage the full candidate lifecycle and just as Bain is only as good as its people, its people are only as good as our process. If you’re interested in learning how a top management consulting firm creates an impressive candidate experience, this is the team for you.

WHAT YOU’LL DO 

- As Associate, Recruiting (m/f/d), you will support our Intern Hire Team in attracting outstanding talent for consulting internships across our offices in Germany & Austria.
- In this role, you will serve as the central point of contact for all candidates throughout the Talent Journey – from the initial contact at a university event through to candidate support during our assessment days.
- You will also be responsible for the pre-selection of the most promising candidates for our selection process and will oversee the preparation, execution and follow-up of our assessment days.
- You give free rein to your creativity in conceptualizing, planning and executing our campus activities and (flagship) recruiting events, and collaborate with your team colleagues to develop strategies and concepts to further advance our intern hiring.
- With your communicative and approachable manner, you also support our internal consultants with all recruiting-related queries.
- To make our recruiting success measurable, you regularly prepare analyses along the Talent Journey and present these to your key stakeholders.

ABOUT YOU

- You have a genuine passion for talent and recruiting.
- You leverage your strong communication skills to attract talented individuals to Bain.
- You have a strong service orientation and a genuine enthusiasm for daily interaction with candidates and Bainies.
- You look forward to taking on responsibility and independently driving topics forward. 
- You are a resilient and assertive organisational talent who does not shy away from challenges and keeps a cool head under pressure.
- You truly thrive in a team setting, built on a foundation of loyalty and reliability.
- You are creative, have a sense of humor and impress with a warm and positive presence.

YOUR EXPERIENCE

- You hold a successfully completed university degree in business administration, social sciences or law, ideally with a focus on human resources management.
- You bring initial experience in recruiting and/or campus marketing. 
- You are proficient in MS Office; initial knowledge of data analytics is an advantage.
- Your German and English language skills are excellent, both spoken and written

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

In addition to an attractive and performance-based remuneration comprising fixed and variable components, you will benefit from numerous additional perks:

- Diverse training formats, language courses as well as buddy and mentoring programmes support your personal development
- You benefit from the EGYM Wellpass and further offerings for fitness and mental wellbeing
- Our mobility concept gives you the flexibility to choose between Mobility Cash, reimbursement of your public transport ticket or JobRad leasing
- For us, flexibility means having the best of both worlds: the freedom to work from home and the opportunity to experience genuine team moments in the office – fully in line with our Work@Bain 2.x concept.
- With our Community Impact Day and participation in Green Teams, you can make a meaningful difference for society and the environment
- Affinity Groups such as Women@Bain promote exchange, networking and career development
- Whether Team Retreat, Christmas Party or the „Bain-Wiesn“ – you will experience how fun and team spirit go hand in hand at Bain.
- Whether free snacks, beverages or the subsidised catering in our cafeteria (in Munich) – you will find even more at Bain that makes your working day a little bit better.

HOW YOU´LL JOIN US

Have we sparked your curiosity about an exceptional career with us? We look forward to receiving your complete application (CV, cover letter, certificates, references) via our application portal.

You'll work with enterprise leaders across industries to demonstrate how Intelligence Center X enables proactive, data-driven decision-making and automated workflows that drive efficiency and competitive advantage.

• Take ownership: Lead the entire sales cycle – from uncovering opportunities to facilitating negotiations and achieving successful deals
Qualifications:• Proven track record of successfully selling enterprise platform solutions such as PaaS, low-code, or AI/data science solutions
• Professional experience selling to Financial Services, Manufacturing, or other key industries with an established network in the DACH region
• Demonstrated ability to manage complex, multi-step sales cycles and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams

• Passion for data-driven strategies, digital transformation, and automation-focused solutions

At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work—hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

FACILITIES MANAGER EUROPE (F/M/D)

At Clario, part of Thermo Fisher Scientific, we develop regulated technology that helps unlock better evidence and improve patient outcomes worldwide. Our software platforms support clinical trials, diagnostics, and medical decision?making in highly controlled regulatory environments.

As Facilities Manager Europe (f/m/d), you will support Clario's facilities across Europe with a focus on our office in Estenfeld, Germany.

WHAT WE OFFER

*
Competitive compensation.

*
Flexible working hours and working time accounts to support the work-life balance.

*
Hybrid work model, allowing for 1-2 days of remote work after the probation period.

*
Support your professional development through internal and external training and certification programs.

*
Attractive benefits (security, flexibility, support and well-being).

*
Engaging employee programs.

WHAT YOU´LL BE DOING

*
Facilities Operations: Providing overall facilities support by ensuring the seamless delivery of facility operations, building management, structural measures, maintenance teams, housekeeping, reception, cafeteria operations, asset management, visitor management, and security & safety protocols. Clario's primary European facilities are situated in Germany, Hungary, Belgium, Switzerland, and Turkey.

*
Facility Layout Standards and Compliance: Supporting facility layout standards for electrical systems, HVAC, IT infrastructure (phones, conference systems, displays), materials, access control and more. Collaborating with local contractors/vendors/departments to manage these processes through to completion, ensuring compliance with local and state building codes.

*
Site Coordination: Managing and coordinating the logistics involved in opening, relocating, or closing a facility, including security systems, access control, furniture, signage, showroom/marketing requirements, telecommunications, and more.

*
Budgeting and Capital Expenditure: Actively participating in the capital expenditure budgeting process and managing purchasing requests for facility needs. Accurately forecasting and preparing facility-related budgets. Conducting financial and business analysis, including preparing reports on expenditures, savings, and areas for cost optimization.

*
Compliance and Standards Development: Ensuring all facilities are operated and maintained in compliance with local, state, and national laws, company standards, and procedures. Responsible for developing and refining standards as business needs evolve, including ensuring annual occupational safety and fire inspections where applicable.

*
Stakeholder and Management Communication: Maintaining a dotted line to the local management teams, participating in and reporting at management meetings. Building strong relationships with key business stakeholders by collecting feedback and delivering reports on business-critical aspects, such as occupancy, site launches, and facility improvements and audits.

*
External Relations and First Point of Contact: Serving as the First Point of Contact for the landlord, labor inspectorate, municipalities, authorities, and occupational safety departments.

*
Vendor and Contractor Management: Building and maintaining strong relationships with local building management and managing third-party contractors/vendors responsible for facility maintenance and operations. This includes monitoring tasks completed, overseeing technical acceptance, and approving invoices.

*
Lease and Contract Management: Managing leases and facility agreements, including understanding legal terms and commercial contract structures. Ensuring contracts are renewed and negotiated in a timely manner.

*
Sustainability and Energy Efficiency: Supporting sustainability initiatives by tracking, reporting, and working towards reducing emissions and waste across facility operations. Implementing energy-saving initiatives, including tracking energy consumption and suggesting areas for improvement.

*
Crisis and Emergency Management: Developing and maintaining emergency response plans for the facility, including fire drills, evacuation procedures, and pandemic-related safety measures.

*
Training and Development: Coordinating safety and facility-related training for employees to ensure everyone is aware of evacuation procedures, safety protocols, and proper usage of shared resources like conference rooms, equipment, and storage areas.

*
Team Collaboration and Support: Contributing to team success by assisting colleagues in resolving internal issues and supporting shared goals.

*
Quality and Standards Management: Ensuring adherence to organizational SOPs by regularly reviewing and understanding operational guidelines. Supporting the establishment and enforcement of departmental standards to maintain consistent quality service.

*
Technical and Industry Development: Enhancing expertise through active participation in company-sponsored training programs and maintaining up-to-date knowledge of industry trends and emerging technologies to drive innovation and informed decision-making.

WHAT WE LOOK FOR

*
Bachelor’s degree in Facility Management or a comparable degree with a technical background, alongside additional business management training or further development.

*
Five or more years of experience in facilities management or an equivalent role, including proven experience in managing technical building projects.

*
Fluent language skills in both German and English are required. Additional language skills are beneficial.

*
Organizational and time management skills to prioritize tasks and meet established schedules, timelines, or deadlines.

*
Creative problem-solving skills with strong project management abilities.

*
Proficiency in working with computer software, including the MS Office suite.

*
Ability to influence others without direct authority.

*
Strong ability to adapt to changing priorities.

*
A strong desire to succeed while maintaining a professional and positive attitude.

*
Flexibility to travel to our European sites as needed, typically averaging two trips per year.

At Clario, our purpose is to transform lives by unlocking better evidence. It’s a cause that unites and inspires us. It’s why we come to work—and how we empower our people to make a positive impact every day. Whether you're advancing clinical science, building innovative technology, or supporting our global teams, your work helps bring life-changing therapies to patients faster.
Ansprechpartner
Sebastian Braun

Antibody Discovery & Development · Martinsried / Munich · Full-time

About us
iOmx Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotech company in the field of immuno-oncology, located in Martinsried/Munich, Germany. We are focused on the development of novel biomarker-supported cancer immunotherapies and are propagating an evolving pipeline of powerful multifunctional antibodies and T cell engagers. We are looking for highly motivated, self-driven and competent colleagues who share our vision and want to help turn it into reality. As part of our Protein Science team within the Antibody Discovery and Development Department, you will focus on the expression of recombinant proteins, antibodies and multispecific molecules in mammalian expression systems. You will advance the development of our transient expression platform, driving the discovery and development of innovative large-molecule biopharmaceuticals. Your responsibilities will include:

Plan and execute transient transfections in HEK and CHO - at various research scales
Develop and optimize our transient expression platforms: process, scale-up, yield, and quality
Run the molecular biology behind it: cloning and plasmid DNA prep at transfection scale
Contribute to construct design and feasibility assessment
Step in as dedicated backup for protein purification and downstream processing
Support analytics: characterization of recombinant proteins using state-of-the-art biochemical and biophysical methods (SDS-PAGE, LAL assay, HPLC)
Take responsibility for protein science lab equipment and infrastructure
Carefully evaluate, interpret, and document results in electronic lab journals and databases
Present data in internal meetings
You are the ideal candidate for this position if you bring the following:

You hold a vocational qualification as CTA, BTA, MTA or an equivalent university degree in a relevant field; at least 4 years of professional laboratory experience is preferred
You have in-depth experience in mammalian cell culture and transient transfection (HEK, CHO)
You have solid experience in cloning and molecular biology techniques; experience in construct design is a plus
You consider downstream processing and adjacent analytical methods as a welcome variety of your daily business
You pay attention to detail in experimental execution and documentation and have solid knowledge of relevant lab techniques and equipment, as well as standard laboratory and MS Office software
You are a well-organized, reliable team player with a hands-on mentality and strong communication skills
You work independently and efficiently, and adapt quickly to changing demands in a collaborative environment
You are proficient in English, both spoken and written
We are a clinical-stage biotechnology company with around 45 employees, driven by a shared purpose: to transform cancer treatment for patients. We work with flat hierarchies and short decision-making processes, in a welcoming and trusting environment where real progress comes from working together. What you can expect from us:

Work that matters: your work feeds directly into our pipeline of cancer immunotherapies, from multifunctional antibodies to T cell engagers on their way to the clinic
Real impact in a small team: your work is visible and you take on responsibility early
A culture of curiosity, integrity, and collaboration: we value diverse perspectives, open communication, and a hands-on mindset, in an environment where people grow together
On top of that: 30 days of vacation, flexible working hours, and support for a job bike or Deutschlandticket

Apply Now
Product Security Senior Specialist (f/m/d) - Cyber Defense Operations

Date: 10/08/2026
Company: SAP

We help the world run better
At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed.

Summary & Role Information:

Join SAP Cloud Infrastructure and help build the next generation of cloud services and platform capabilities powering SAP's sovereign and regulated cloud environments.

As a Product Security Senior Specialist, you will be the operational backbone of our Cyber Defense capability — coordinating and steering our external managed SOC partner, integrating security tooling into our cloud operations stack, and ensuring consistent detection, response, and monitoring across 30+ regional datacenters globally, from Australia to Toronto. You will work in close alignment with an internal Expert who leads the Cyber Defense topic strategically, while owning the day-to-day execution independently. We are looking for someone who is self-motivated, well-organized, and can operate with minimal supervision in a fast-moving, globally distributed environment.

What You'll Do:

- Serve as the primary operational interface to our external managed SOC provider and as the primary escalation contact for internal teams during security incidents. Steer service delivery, manage and prioritize the operational backlog, plan sprints and deliverables in line with shifting priorities, define and refine detection use cases, manage escalation processes, and ensure SLA adherence across all regions.
- Integrate and maintain the security toolbelt for SAP Cloud Infrastructure's logging, monitoring, and detection capabilities. Ensure tooling coverage keeps pace with platform expansion into new regions.
- Coordinate incident response processes between the external SOC, internal engineering teams, and stakeholders. Ensure timely triage, containment, and resolution of security events — executing against defined runbooks and operational processes, and continuously identifying improvements as the threat landscape and platform evolve.
- Work with the SOC provider and internal teams to develop and refine threat detection rules, analyze threat intelligence, and adapt the detection strategy to the evolving threat landscape for cloud infrastructure.
- Support vulnerability management processes for SAP Cloud Infrastructure, ensuring findings from scanning, penetration testing, and threat intelligence are tracked, prioritized, and remediated.
- Maintain operational metrics, dashboards, and reporting for Cyber Defense operations. Provide regular status updates to the Cyber Defense Expert and Security Engineering leadership. Identify gaps and inefficiencies in existing operational workflows and tooling, and drive actionable improvements.
- Adapt Cyber Defense operations, tooling, and processes as SAP Cloud Infrastructure expands into new regions with specific regulatory requirements.
- Collaborate across teams to transform security requirements into reliable and observable solutions.

What You Bring:

Technical Foundation

- Several years of experience in security operations — SOC operations, incident response, threat detection, or vulnerability management — in a cloud or large-scale infrastructure environment.
- Hands-on experience managing security incidents, including triage, escalation, containment, and post-incident review in cloud or large-scale infrastructure environments.
- Experience coordinating or managing an external managed SOC provider, including service steering, use-case development, and escalation management.
- Working knowledge of logging, monitoring, and SIEM/SOAR tooling in cloud environments.
- Familiarity with OpenStack and/or Kubernetes from a security operations perspective.
- Experience operating security for multi-region, 24x7 datacenter environments.
- Familiarity with regulatory frameworks relevant to cloud infrastructure operations (e.g. ISO 27001, SOC 2, C5, BSI IT-Grundschutz, ANSSI SecNumCloud).
- Ability to work independently, prioritize across multiple regions and time zones, and manage operational complexity without close supervision.
- Proficiency in scripting and coding for automation of security operations tasks.

We don't expect you to have experience with every technology listed. If you have a strong foundation in several of these areas and are interested in learning the others, we'd be happy to hear from you.

Core AI Skills

- AI-assisted engineering is part of how we work at SAP.
- Experience using AI tools for engineering tasks such as coding, troubleshooting, documentation, and automation.
- Ability to provide effective context and instructions and critically review AI-generated outputs before using them in production.
- Experience using AI to support automation, infrastructure tooling, or prototyping.
- Willingness to share useful AI practices and contribute to their responsible use within the team.

Professional Skills

- Comfortable collaborating across teams, cultures, and locations and sharing knowledge with others.
- Able to communicate technical topics clearly, both verbally and in writing.
- Structured and reliable, with the ability to take ownership while working collaboratively. Able to manage a shifting backlog, re-prioritize deliverables as context changes, and keep external teams aligned to current priorities.
- Curious and pragmatic when approaching unfamiliar or complex problems.
- Strong stakeholder management skills, including the ability to navigate escalation paths and establish the right contact persons in the face of a dynamically growing organizational environment.
- Fluent English. German preferred. French appreciated.

Tech You Bring

- SIEM/SOAR platforms
- Logging and monitoring tooling
- OpenStack or comparable cloud infrastructure platforms
- Kubernetes ecosystem
- GitHub for configuration and issue management
- Python, Bash, or comparable scripting languages
- Cloud computing environments
- Observability tools such as Prometheus and Grafana
- Threat intelligence platforms
- Ticketing systems such as Jira and ServiceNow

Meet the Team:

You will join SAP Cloud Infrastructure Security Engineering, where we build the infrastructure behind SAP's enterprise, sovereign, and regulated cloud environments using technologies such as OpenStack, Kubernetes/Gardener, Ceph, and Prometheus.

Our engineering culture is hands-on and collaborative. We work on real infrastructure problems, share what we learn, and believe a private cloud is something you build, not something you rent.

​

Bring out your best
SAP innovations help more than four hundred thousand customers worldwide work together more efficiently and use business insight more effectively. Originally known for leadership in enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, SAP has evolved to become a market leader in end-to-end business application software and related services for database, analytics, intelligent technologies, and experience management. As a cloud company with two hundred million users and more than one hundred thousand employees worldwide, we are purpose-driven and future-focused, with a highly collaborative team ethic and commitment to personal development. Whether connecting global industries, people, or platforms, we help ensure every challenge gets the solution it deserves. At SAP, you can bring out your best.

We win with inclusion
SAP’s culture of inclusion, focus on health and well-being, and flexible working models help ensure that everyone – regardless of background – feels included and can run at their best. At SAP, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential. We ultimately believe in unleashing all talent and creating a better world.

SAP is committed to the values of Equal Employment Opportunity and provides accessibility accommodations to applicants with physical and/or mental disabilities. If you are interested in applying for employment with SAP and are in need of accommodation or special assistance to navigate our website or to complete your application, please send an e-mail with your request to Recruiting Operations Team: Careers@sap.com.
